                     Chained SHA-256: Test Vectors

Abstract

   This text is a test fixture for vector's iterated vectors, laid out
   as an RFC's plain text so that vector reads it.  It is not an RFC.

1.  Chaining

   A chain starts from the text "abc".  For each iteration, set the
   text to the result of calling sha256Hex on it.  The final result is
   the text left after the last iteration.

   Every digest a chain feeds back MUST be written in the digits 0-9
   and a-f, as sha256Hex writes it.

   Chains are run for 1 iteration, for 1,000 iterations and for
   100,000 iterations.
